task: Contact-consistent whole-body retargeting from markerless estimated human motion to G1 simulation

decision.reason: Kinematic contact improved, but acceptance drops and dynamics do not consistently improve; all ten paired cases fail full imitation. No parameter adjustment after selection freeze.
enabled_evaluation_fixes: Source thigh/shank direction audit, without scoring invented foot twist
Balance by replay stage and height relative to requested height
Standing stop requires upright final 0.2s, retaining legacy speed-only result

evidence_scope.additional_dynamics_case: public_s6_long; already used for vision evaluation, not wholly unseen data
evidence_scope.perception: Cached CUDA markerless detections and source-derived 3D estimates; no labels or synthetic animation truth used
evidence_scope.contact_truth: Unavailable. Ankle-based support hypotheses are not measured force/contact or calibrated probabilities.
evidence_scope.reference_target: Original source joint references, path and estimated leg directions retained; not independent MoCap truth
evidence_scope.comparability: Reference FK uses common accepted frames and identical support-pivot identity. Dynamic sample counts can differ; no accuracy improvement claimed from unpaired means. Contact speed includes actual simulated contacts and post-fall periods, not a certified stable-walking measure.
evidence_scope.source_frame_coverage_warning: S6 source acceptance is 512/750, below the existing 70% imitation gate before any projection.

method.input: Accepted 35-dimensional TWIST source reference, corrected anchored root XYZ m, source heading rad, integer exposure ns; current source ankles and leg length m
method.coordinates: World Z up; root XY anchored at first accepted source pelvis; velocity in heading-local coordinates
method.support: Causal five-sample velocity fit, low ankle envelope, body-size-normalized gates, three-frame confirmation and accumulated drift release; low moving feet remain unknown
method.projection: G1 model FK with analytic Jacobians; 12 leg angles, base height and bounded XY correction; hard joint/rate/fidelity, nonpenetration and optional point-anchor constraints
method.root_correction: Each world XY axis bounded to +/-0.08m and correction rate to 0.25m/s; velocity corrected consistently; does not generate independent gait
method.unknowns: Full sole orientation and contact pivot identity not observed; point chosen from model lowest sole sphere. Flat sole and swing-neutral ablations rejected.
method.failure: Rejected/stale/gapped sources withdraw anchors. Infeasible solutions return accepted=false. Invalid clocks/geometry/frame raise ValueError and clear prior contact. No unconstrained fallback.
limitations: No self-collision avoidance in this projector
No policy adaptation or physical G1 testing
Rate bounds hold only within continuous accepted segments; downstream controller handles transitions
Current source leg direction audit removes heading; root heading/path require separate scoring

selection_freeze.reason: Development acceptance loss and inconsistent dynamics prohibit default promotion. Freeze for additional diagnostics, not parameter tuning.
selection_freeze.new_dynamics_subject: public_s6_long; previously used for vision evaluation, not a wholly unseen dataset
selection_freeze.criteria: No acceptance loss; no deterioration of dynamic balance, original-source leg tracking, or root path; all existing acceptance thresholds retained.

evaluation_revision.change: Stopping now also requires upright final 0.2s. Preserve old speed-only result. Frozen candidate/config/control/source selection unchanged; all trials rerun with this same stricter evaluation.

config.ground_assumption: Flat target simulation floor; source ankle support level is a proxy, not a measured sole plane

freeze.decision: Experimental; require no lower acceptance or worse dynamic balance/limb tracking before default promotion

findings: Hard flat sole overconstrained unobserved orientation and reduced S2 acceptance 590 to 534; point-contact plus drift release reduced the loss to four frames after root correction.
At S4/S6, 748/353 same-pivot pairs have near-zero reference pivot displacement, but simulated contact speed and pelvis tracking do not improve. This is not a solved physical foot-slip result.
Straight baseline first violates historical balance at 8.30s in return_to_stand; tracking max tilt is 0.269rad. Candidate first violation is 8.12s. Stop transition remains unresolved.
S2 historical height threshold is crossed at 1.90s during commanded crouch alignment (height about0.471m, relative height deviation under0.011m); do not label all fixed-height failures as falls.
S4/S6 do fail during tracking, not just shutdown. End-of-replay zero speed can mean a fallen robot, now rejected by the stopping audit.

validation.device_scope: Low-dimensional projection remains CPU. Existing vision results came from fixed CUDA caches; no new GPU inference was needed.
validation.timing_scope: Wall time per input frame, including early rejects; some verification processes ran concurrently. Not exposure-to-command latency or a real-time certificate.

cleanup.preserved: All original inputs, environments, final baseline/candidate references, frozen configurations and numeric reports

research.title: OmniRetarget
research.used: Contact and morphology constraints must preserve interaction; downstream learned tracking is separately evaluated. This implementation is not a reproduction.

research.title: GMR official motion_retarget.py
research.used: Frame pose retargeting and model-bound limits as a reference; they do not establish dynamic contact feasibility.

next_core_problem: Joint centroidal balance/contact-force feasibility and phase-aware stopping, followed by tracking-policy adaptation; evaluate original same-side limb motion and source pelvis path without fabricating a velocity gait.
